payload.body:
The workflow 'enrich' failed on GitHub Actions and nothing else would have told you.

  repo:     dk-forge/talent-intelligence-tracker
  workflow: enrich
  branch:   main
  trigger:  workflow_dispatch
  run:      https://github.com/dk-forge/talent-intelligence-tracker/actions/runs/32126391985

WHAT FAILED:
  pipeline.publish.PublishError: /enrich did not answer after 4 attempts: 504: <!DOCTYPE html>

What to do: open a Claude Code session in the talent-intelligence-tracker repo and paste this line:
  "The GitHub Actions workflow 'enrich' is failing on main with: pipeline.publish.PublishError: /enrich did not answer after 4 attempts: 504: <!DOCTYPE html>. The run is https://github.com/dk-forge/talent-intelligence-tracker/actions/runs/32126391985. Reproduce it locally with `.venv/bin/pytest -q`, find the root cause, and fix it."

You will get ONE more email about this workflow: a RECOVERED notice on its next green run. We suppress repeats of this same failure deliberately. An alarm that mails eight times in an afternoon is one you learn to filter, and a filtered alarm is how a wrong number stays live for hours.

entries.repaired_because: key ci-noise:2026-W32 was rejected 400 'bad dedupe_key' 16 times: /alert accepts ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9:._-]{0,159}$ and the ISO week carried an uppercase W. Rewritten to ci-noise:2026-w32; ci_noise_report.py now composes %G-w%V. Attempts zeroed because this is a different, deliverable key, and leaving it past FAIL_LOUD_ATTEMPTS would keep host-watch red on an alert that is about to succeed.
